_comment: Registry for the GitHub Projects v2 boards provisioner (provision_projects.py). One entry per board; 'key' is the CLI selector, 'title' is the exact board title on GitHub (adopt-by-title: an existing board with this title is ADOPTED, never re-created; alternatively pin 'existing_node_id'). 'repos' are linked to the board (issues can be added from any repo regardless — linking only aids the UI pickers). 'standard_fields' are created per board when missing (single-select custom fields). The BUILT-IN Status field cannot be reliably reshaped via the API: 'status_options' is the TARGET the check mode diffs against and reports; reconciling Status options is a one-time manual UI step (see the owner's PROJECTS_BOARDS.md (kriegerdataforge-context/ops/)). 'collaborators' are best-effort invites (user-owned project support varies — manual UI invite is the documented fallback). See ADR D-010 / docs/design/reports-ecosystem.md.
_repo_field_comment: No custom 'Repo'/'Repository' field is created: those names are RESERVED by GitHub Projects v2 (it has a BUILT-IN Repository field that auto-populates from each item's issue/PR — group/filter board views by that instead). createProjectV2Field rejects them with 'Name cannot have a reserved value' (caught live 2026-07-12).
_new_boards_note: KDF — CICD and KDF — Personal Portfolio hold no node id until the owner's first execute makes them, adopted by title until their ids are pinned here. KDF — Business Portfolio is the board pinned before as KDF — Portfolios, its title renamed by the owner, since the provisioner never renames. The tickets repo holds the public repos' tickets, so it sits on exactly their three boards, the one repo the partition lets on more than one.
_excluded_notes: Board node ids were harvested from the first execute (2026-07-12) and pinned in existing_node_id, so re-runs ADOPT these exact boards (no adopt-by-title duplicate risk if a title is edited). The Fitness board is the one wired into fitness-app-backend's GH_REPORTS_*PROJECT_ID env; if a different pre-existing Fitness board should be canonical, replace fitness.existing_node_id with its id before the next run.
